resources.string: Local long-press menu and saved-video export

Off by default. Re-enter a video after enabling. On recognized offline entries, long-press the video while playing or paused for local actions; Toki translation/caption fetches remain local even if Wi-Fi is connected. Export currently requires the inspected 47.6.3 cache code, Android 10+, and a complete non-fragmented local MP4. Partial, encrypted, split audio/video and unsupported caches are not fetched or exported. Offline comments and a local translation model are not yet included.
